title: feat(app-shell): an authored record page is drawn on the desktop full page only; a phone and the side drawer draw the standard page (#36150)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuKobRqmoXkrWkHE4z9tvY3k)_

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVHYk1S4MD4WibYGKk

Fixes #36150

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: follow-up #36179 — skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md rules 4 and 5 (the `record_more` advice); skills edits ride a domain:skills PR

## 维护者速读

- 手写的记录页（`kind: 'full'`）现在只在电脑整页上生效。手机整页、电脑右侧抽屉（以及分栏预览、界面页预览）一律画平台标准页：字段一列、每张子表一个页签、动态在最后。抽屉里「整页打开」打开的仍是手写页。
- 按您的两条裁决：审批请求页和用户页三处都保留自己的页；页面区块里的动作（`record_section`）标准页不画，演示应用任务的「重算工时」加了 `record_more`，手机和抽屉里在「⋯」里能找到；队列成员、审计日志「同一记录的变更」、发票的打印按钮只在电脑整页有（后续卡由席位立）。
- 不变：插槽页（HotCRM 线索、工单的告警，项目的甘特图）三处照旧；网址点名的页面（打印页等）照旧；电脑整页一点不变。
- HotCRM 主干已经没有手写整页（hotcrm#2671），所以 HotCRM 三处都没有变化，作对照；手写页的三处效果用演示应用的项目页拍。

## What changes

- **One reader of where an authored page applies**, `authoredRecordPageApplies` in the new `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordPageSurface.ts`: true on the desktop full page, false on a phone (`usePhoneViewport`) and in every embedded view. Two exceptions are the host's, named there and nowhere else: a page named in the URL (`…/record/:id/page/:pageName`, which only the full-page route reads, objectui#12715), and `OBJECTS_KEEPING_AUTHORED_PAGE` = `sys_approval_request`, `sys_user` (maintainer rulings 7066490078). There is no author switch.
- **`RecordDetailView`**: `usePhoneViewport()` moves up to where the page is assigned, and `assignedPage` is `null` where the authored page does not apply, so the view takes the synthesized standard page there. Inside the view everything downstream (columns, phone header, comments, related lists) keys off `assignedPage`. Slotted pages never populate `assignedPage` and keep their slots everywhere.
- **The record route's object scope** (`console/appObjectScope.ts`, L2 M1): `declaredRecordPage` reads the same `authoredRecordPageApplies`, so on a phone the record route takes the synthesized page's arm (the objects pointing at the record's, from the bundle or the registry) instead of only the objects the authored page binds; the standard page's child tabs are then all there. `AppContent` and `useAppObjectScopePrefetch` hand it `usePhoneViewport()`, so the scope follows the width across 768 as the view does. A page named in the URL and the two kept platform pages still read their page's objects.
- **Showcase**: `showcase_recalc_estimate` declares `['record_section', 'record_more']` (ruling 7066506909). The authored Task Detail header lists its action ids and leaves it out, so the full page still draws it once, in the section bar; the standard page reaches it under ⋯. `record-action-location-hosts.test.ts` now holds: the authored header lists the record_header / record_more set less the section bar's actions; no action is both a section action and an inline header one; every section action is reachable under ⋯ on the standard page.
- **Docs**: `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` gains "Where an authored page applies" (a window narrower than 768 px counts as the phone; an interface page's preview is embedded).
- **Not in this PR** (L2 S1, seat): the spec describes of `kind`, `isDefault`, `apps` and the `slots.tabs` remedy → #36180 (schema face); `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md` rules 4 and 5 and the `record_more` advice → #36179 (domain:skills).
- **Changeset**: `@object-ui/app-shell` minor, both declaration lines.

## Why

Card #36150 (child of epic #35590; maintainer 2026-11-22 「自定义记录页在手机和右侧预览里不生效、统一用标准页」). The card's item 5 list (page-only things, and what each becomes off the full page) was posted on the card before the build; the two questions it raised were ruled (7066490078, 7066506909).

### Item 5, and how each was handled

| Page | Page-only | Off the desktop full page now |
|---|---|---|
| showcase project | Tasks inline-edit grid tab, three sections, own highlights, footer discussion | standard page: Tasks as the master-detail child tab, ungrouped fields, the object's own highlights, discussion in 动态 (the comment panel once #36114 lands) |
| showcase task | review banner, Recalculate Estimate (section bar), three sections, path | banner gone; Recalculate under ⋯ (`record_more` added); stage menu in the header |
| showcase settings | two sections | ungrouped |
| showcase invoice (default print page) | letterhead, print line items, Print button | standard page, no Print button (full page only, ruled) |
| `sys_approval_request` | `record:approval_decision` | **kept on every surface** (ruled) |
| `sys_user` | Security tab, effective access, AI assistants, verify banner, picker | **kept on every surface** until #35897 (ruled) |
| `sys_organization` | three related tabs with set columns | the three stay; the other lookups to the organization also become tabs until #35897 |
| `sys_queue` | Members list paired by text value | full page only (ruled; follow-up card by the seat) |
| `sys_audit_log` | "Changes to the same record" list, five sections | list full page only (ruled; same follow-up); ungrouped |
| HotCRM main | no authored full page since hotcrm#2671 | no change on any surface |

## Side effects reviewers should know

- **Seventeen `RecordDetailView.*` test files mounted the drawer (`embedded`) only as a harness for an authored page** (`feedGrant-12082`, `feedCommentEditDelete-12268`, `reactionRecords-12078`, `authoredActivityThreading-12249`, `reactionWriteFailure-10899`, `withheldMentions-28218`, `discussionFallbackPipeline-8983`, `discussionExplicitComposition-7298`, `commentWriteFailure-10899`, `reactionsCommentRowsOnly-11035`, `reactionKeepIds-11019`, `feedRecordScope`, `topInset-35745`, `oneProvenanceFooter-12307`, `appendInset-27520`, `replyCountOnRead-12144`, `feedLoading`). They now mount the full page, with a one-line note where `embedded` was; no assertion changed. One case changed meaning: `harness` › recordPagePlacesNoComponent-32478 "the record drawer explains it the same way" now pins that the drawer draws the standard page and no explanation, since the authored page does not apply there.
- **#36114** (desktop comment panel) is merged; `main` is merged into this branch. Its pin "no icon on a hand-written page" (`commentsPanel-36075.test.tsx`) now mounts the full page, where an authored page keeps its discussion and shows no icon; a new case beside it pins the opposite on the drawer: an authored-page object's drawer draws the standard page and offers the panel (L1-c item 1).
- The phone reading is the window width (`usePhoneViewport`, below 768): a desktop window narrowed below 768 also takes the standard page.

## Verification

- New `AppContent.authoredPagePhoneScope-36150.test.tsx` (6), through the real `AppContent` and `MetadataProvider`, the view a double printing the objects it is handed: desktop reads the authored page's objects, a child it does not bind left out (CONTROL); a phone reads every object pointing at the record's, that child included; the width crossing 768 on an open record moves the scope; a media-query change that leaves the window wide (what printing fires) keeps the authored page's scope (L2 N4); on a phone a page named in the URL and the `sys_user` page still read their own objects. **Red before**: with the scope handed `phone = false`, 2 of 6 fail (phone, width crossing).
- New `RecordDetailView.authoredPageDesktopOnly-36150.test.tsx` (19, one added for N4: the authored page survives a print-style media-query change), through the real `RecordDetailView`: an authored page draws on the desktop full page; the standard page with its tab strip on the phone (375) and the drawer, the authored block gone; on the drawer the object's `record_more` action is in ⋯. CONTROL: no authored page, the standard page on all three. Exceptions on the phone and the drawer: a slotted page keeps its slot; `sys_approval_request` and `sys_user` keep their page; a page named in the URL draws on the phone. **Red before**: with the reader returning `true`, 4 of 18 fail (the unit pin, phone, drawer, ⋯).
- Local: every `app-shell` `RecordDetailView.*`, `recordDrawer*`, `ObjectView*` and `console/__tests__/AppContent*` file, plus every other `ui/` test file naming `RecordDetailView`, `recordDrawer` or `RecordPageDrawerHost`: 319 files, 3,003 tests, all pass. `examples/app-showcase` `record-action-location-hosts.test.ts` 14/14; `objectstack validate` passes. ESLint on every changed file: 0 errors. `overlap-check.mjs`: clean against main and the 4 open PRs that share a file (#36136, #36129, #36114, #35923). `type-check` for app-shell did not run locally (the ui packages' declarations are not built in this container); CI is the reading.
- Browser, showcase on this branch (server 18.6.0, console from this branch's `ui/` on Vite), zh-CN, light and dark, shots in the project evidence folder `build-seat1/36150/`:

| Surface | Showcase project | Showcase task |
|---|---|---|
| Desktop full page, 1280 | authored: tabs 详情 / 任务 / 相关 2 / 附件, footer 讨论 | authored: path, review banner slot, 重算工时 in the section bar, once |
| Drawer from the list, 1280 | standard: 概览 / 字段动物园 1 / 成员 1 / 任务 2 / 客户简报 / 附件 / 动态 | standard: 概览 / 动态; ⋯ holds 打开文档, **重算工时**, 重算所选 … 整页打开 |
| Phone, 390 | standard: 概览 / 字段动物园 1 / 成员 1 / 任务 2 / 更多 3, fields one column, bottom bar | standard; ⋯ holds 记录工时, 归档, **重算工时** … |

- HotCRM main (`1468877`, on 18.6.0) as the no-change control, lead: the standard page with its tabs on all three surfaces (it is a slotted page), its record actions in the header / ⋯ (转化线索, 安排跟进, 记录通话 …).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (ESLint on the changed files, 0 errors).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block is the maintainer's summary, in the maintainer's language).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
